name: 🛡 Safe Cron Gate
info:
Blocks when SYSTEM_SHUTDOWN is set, during quiet hours (ET), or duplicate window.

Input: any msg
Env: QUIET_START (21:00), QUIET_END (08:00), DEDUPE_KEY, DEDUPE_SEC
Out 1: allowed
Out 2: blocked

name: Gate
🌐 Leads API Call
info:
Calls ShamrockLeads automation/API with GAS_API_KEY.

Input:
  msg.leadsPath e.g. /api/automation/health
  msg.method GET|POST (default GET)
  msg.payload body for POST

Out 1: success (status < 400)
Out 2: error

name: Prep request
Validate
📢 Slack Notify
info:
Posts to Slack chat.postMessage.
msg.payload = text or {text, channel, blocks}
msg.skipSlack = true to skip
Out 1: posted
Out 2: skipped/error

name: Prep Slack
Route result
🔒 HMAC Webhook Guard
info:
Validates X-Shamrock-Signature HMAC-SHA256.
Out 1: ok
Out 2: reject (sets statusCode 403)

name: Verify
🧹 PII Redact Log
info:
Redacts phones/emails/SSN-like strings in msg.payload for safe logging.
Sets msg.logSafe. Passes original on out 1.

name: Redact
📜 GAS Action Call
info:
POST to GAS web app.
msg.payload.action required (or msg.gasAction)
Out 1 success / Out 2 error

name: Prep GAS
Validate GAS

info:
